problem: I build landing pages with Claude Code and every one of them looks like the same AI template.
solution: Install the frontend-design skill: one folder in ~/.claude/skills, and Claude Code stops reaching for its defaults (the same font, the purple gradient, the centered hero) on every page it builds.
share_identity: if you ship client sites with Claude Code
takeaway: copy one skill folder once and every page you generate after that stops looking generated
deliverable: the install command plus a before and after checklist of the defaults the skill bans
one_true_thing: One folder copied into ~/.claude/skills changes every frontend Claude Code builds

evidence.note: the skill is published in anthropics/skills
it installs by copying the folder
the defaults it steers away from

solution_decision.name: the frontend-design skill (anthropics/skills)
